"""Main-only exact offline b9 admission. Original proofs remain immutable."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-controller-source-v2'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xe_b9_admission_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path))

def passed(path, commands=False):
    x = json.loads(path.read_text())
    m.require(x.get('passed') and x.get('complete') and x.get('active') is False and not x.get('error'), 'closed proof ' + str(path))
    if commands:
        m.require(x['commands'] and all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
                  for c in x['commands']), 'anchored commands ' + str(path))
    return x

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-admission-root-v1'
    m.require(not out.exists(), 'fresh admission only')
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), started_utc=m.utc(), main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, argv):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, P, wall=120, cpu=180,
                             rss_cap=4 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20,
                             file_cap=8 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
    try:
        build_path = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-xe-free-build-root-v1/record.json'
        build = passed(build_path, commands=True)
        passed(B / 'main-current-xe-b9-xe-contrib-llvm-build-root-v1/record.json', commands=True)
        passed(B / 'main-current-xe-b9-host-tests-root-v1/record.json', commands=True)
        cpu_path = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-controller-cpu-root-v1/record.json'
        cpu = passed(cpu_path, commands=True)
        q = json.loads((P / 'qualification.pending.json').read_text())
        code = {f.name: m.sha(f) for f in P.glob('*.py')}
        m.require(len(code) == 7 and code == cpu['controller_source_pins'] == q['controller_source_pins'], 'actual CPU-qualified closure')
        prod = json.loads((P / 'production-source-pins.json').read_text())
        m.require(q['production_source_pins'] == prod['source_pins'], 'actual production closure')
        m.require(q['binaries']['xe'] == {k:build['binary'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}, 'actual unmodified free ELF')
        m.require(m.sha(build['binary']['path']) == build['binary']['sha256'], 'ELF unchanged')
        for name, digest in q['production_source_pins']['xe'].items():
            actual = Path(build['source_tree']) / name
            m.require(m.sha(actual) == digest, 'source identity ' + name)
            m.require(build['source_pins'].get(name) == digest or name == 'LOCAL.md', 'build source closure ' + name)
        for recipe in build['build_recipe'].values():
            m.require(m.sha(recipe['path']) == recipe['sha256'], 'unchanged compiled recipe')
        report_path = B / 'research-20261009/research-xe-b9-segmented-serve-route-round308-v1.txt'
        m.require(m.sha(report_path) == '98eaca685cb9c2af3116d3a24ff5db3152e0f21d2539b05f33be3c0d5b95ddad', 'received immutable route report')
        old_path = B / 'latest-update-main-admission-prepare-root-v4/resolved/qualification.json'
        old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())
        e = dict(old['engines']['xe'])
        for group in ['mapped_libraries','health_libraries']:
            for item in e[group].values():
                m.require(m.sha(item['path']) == item['sha256'], 'same exact qualified runtime library')
        m.require(m.sha(e['health_binary']['path']) == e['health_binary']['sha256'], 'same qualified integer probe')
        model_path = Path(old['model_identity_receipt']['path'])
        m.require(m.sha(model_path) == old['model_identity_receipt']['sha256'], 'full model identity proof unchanged')
        identity = passed(model_path)
        m.require(identity['full_hashes_verified'] and identity['main_reviewed'] and not identity['model_launch_attempted'], 'actual full-hash model evidence')
        for item in identity['model_inputs']:
            stat = Path(item['path']).stat()
            actual = dict(device=stat.st_dev, inode=stat.st_ino, bytes=stat.st_size,
                          mtime_ns=stat.st_mtime_ns, ctime_ns=stat.st_ctime_ns)
            m.require(actual == item['stat'], 'unchanged full-hashed model file metadata')
        q.update(status='passed', main_reviewed=True, controller_source_pins=code,
                 production_source_manifest_sha256=m.sha(P / 'production-source-pins.json'),
                 tools={k:pin(Path('/usr/bin') / v) for k,v in
                        [('git','git'),('journalctl','journalctl'),('systemctl','systemctl'),('python','python3')]},
                 model_identity_receipt=old['model_identity_receipt'], model_inputs=identity['model_inputs'])
        review = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True,
                      gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, controller_source_pins=code,
                      original_source_only_report=pin(B / 'research-20261009/implementation-xe-b9-pristine-controller-source-v1.txt'),
                      cpu_proof=pin(cpu_path), selected_route_report=pin(report_path),
                      main_review=['Seven actual helper diffs reviewed; source-only parent unchanged.',
                                   'No-batch/no-MTP serial serve returns before one-shot session loop.',
                                   'Segmented verify waits for compute before payload reads and copy before next launch.',
                                   'Resident graph and new interop copy stream explicitly disabled.',
                                   'Host-only stager atomics with event-gated buffer reuse; no device polling.',
                                   'Strict complete32K/GEN16 LP5, live diagnostic scanning, finite owner budgets, normalQUIT retained.'],
                      limitations=['Source admission only; no whole-engine portable safety, model quality, full262144 or RESTORE claim.',
                                   'Unmodified Xe ignores some intermediate event return values; severe runtime diagnostics fail.',
                                   'Controlled prior settings, not an optimized parameter comparison.'])
        review_path = out / 'controller-review.json'
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, indent=2) + '\n')
        q['receipts'] = dict(controller_cpu=pin(cpu_path), controller_review=pin(review_path))
        base = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True,
                    binary=q['binaries']['xe'], source_pins=q['production_source_pins']['xe'],
                    model_inference_tested=False)
        source = dict(base, gpu_executed=False, pristine_source_patch_applied=False,
                      selected_route_report=pin(report_path), selected_path_errors_fatal=True,
                      copy_engine_disabled_reviewed=True, selected_route_has_no_concurrent_host_device_polling=True,
                      ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed=True,
                      route='ordinary serial serve; batched8192 GPU prompt; segmented T1 verifier; sourceLLVM nativeL0v2; no resident graph, copy interop, host polling, MTP, batches or pipelines')
        source_path = out / 'xe-source-review.json'
        source_path.write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2) + '\n')
        wrapper = dict(base, commands=build['commands'], guard_commands=[], gpu_executed=False,
                       inference_executable_built=True, compiler_provider='source-llvm-7.1.1',
                       backend='xe', strata_enable_sycl=False, original_receipt=pin(build_path),
                       original_build_recipe=build['build_recipe'], original_revision=build['revision'])
        build_wrapper = out / 'xe-build.json'
        build_wrapper.write_text(json.dumps(wrapper, indent=2) + '\n')
        runtime_wrapper = out / 'xe-runtime.json'
        runtime_wrapper.write_text(json.dumps(dict(base, mapped_libraries=e['mapped_libraries'],
            health_binary=e['health_binary'], original_provider_receipt=pin(B / 'latest-update-main-runtime-pins-root-v2/record.json'),
            qualification_scope='Unchanged SHA-pinned actual provider mappings only; new model startup not yet validated.'), indent=2) + '\n')
        e.update(main_route_admitted=True, native_ple_admitted=True, selected_path_errors_are_fatal=True,
                 ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed=True, copy_engine_disabled_reviewed=True,
                 selected_route_has_no_concurrent_host_device_polling=True,
                 receipts=dict(build=pin(build_wrapper), source_route_review=pin(source_path),
                               runtime_review=pin(runtime_wrapper)))
        q['engines'] = {'xe':e}
        qualification = out / 'qualification.json'
        qualification.write_text(json.dumps(q, indent=2) + '\n')
        code_text = "from pathlib import Path;from common import admit,load;from policy import HERE; q=load(Path(__import__('sys').argv[1]));admit(q,'xe',load(HERE/'production-source-pins.json'));print('PASS b9 exact-source admission; no GPU launch')"
        run('actual-admission', ['/usr/bin/python3','-B','-c',code_text,str(qualification)])
        r.update(qualification=pin(qualification), passed=True, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','error','qualification']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
